audit.why: Full Brand-favored chart (6-8/10 every row) matches the kits: Rell has no ranged poke or sustain and Brand's Sear stun interrupts her dash-dependent all-in. Both layers already agree row by row.

Level 2 (W-Q punishes her weak early clear), level 6 (Sear interrupts Full Tilt before Magnet Storm can land), and first item (Liandry's shreds her tank HP) are the real spikes and are already named correctly.
